title: Accessibility: Contrast Ratios for Dynamic Colors
hints: Linearise each sRGB channel before weighting.
jsBridge: WCAG contrast is the same formula on the web and iOS. The iOS twist is **dynamic colours**: each colour has light, dark and increased-contrast variants, and every pair must pass in every mode.
